targets.title: Do motivated classmates matter for educational success?
targets.evidence_quote: We reproduced and replicated the findings of Bietenbeck (2025).
targets.outcome_computational_quote:
Overall, every step of the replication, from raw data, to the cleaned
data, to the figures and tables in the paper replicated quasi-perfectly.
targets.outcome_robustness_quote:
We conducted several robustness
checks by using different versions of the main explanatory variable (peer motivation).
The findings are robust to these changes.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Original data and code were reanalysed. Authors state numerical reproduction and robustness to alternative variable constructions; minor discrepancies do not change conclusions.

reasoning: A completed reproduction of one original paper, with both computational and alternative-specification checks. Identity verified against report title and all three authors.
